description: Connect GNOME management flows to the system bus (v1 + v2 contract)

key_changes.dbus_client: Connection::session() -> Connection::system(); method names aligned to frozen v1/v2 contract (PascalCase); v2 methods added (ListPamServices, SetPamServiceEnabled, GetProtectionStatus)
key_changes.client_trait: Rewritten to match daemon contract: start_enrollment(uid, name), commit_profile(session) -> String, poll_progress(session) -> Option<EnrollmentProgress>, review_profile, get_status, v2 PAM/protection methods; &self instead of &mut self
key_changes.presenter: No-op commit_profile removed; uid stored; async dispatch via glib::spawn_future with cancellation; from_arc for reconnect testing; PAM toggles and protection status wired
key_changes.fake: Updated to match new trait; PAM services and protection status added; commit_profile returns Err on low diversity (matching daemon behavior)
